note: Missing `accessToken` — the Management Client's token is the evidence of the person's authority (HCP 6.1.9, 9.3).
A `status` HCP does not define — `ended` is the only value HCP 9.4.13 names.
Unknown top-level request member — the delegations list is not paginated (HCP 9.4.13).
Missing `delegations` — the result always carries the array, empty when there are none (HCP 9.4.13).
An ended delegation with a reason HCP 17.6 does not define.
A member in the response besides `delegations` — the list is not paginated, so there is no `nextCursor` (HCP 9.4.13).
